old_path: # old_path = an address on the old msca09aa.org WordPress site (start and end with /). new_path = the page on this site that replaces it. Each row becomes a small page that forwards visitors (and Google) to the new address, so links on flyers, QR codes, district websites and aa.org keep working.

# An old_path ending in * matches every address that starts with it (e.g. /event/*); those are forwarded by the "page not found" page instead. Never use the address of a page that exists on this site (e.g. /calendar/): the site check stops with an error. Old Delegate's Corner posts are forwarded automatically from the old_url in src/content/delegate/*.md.
